explanations: isProduction is computed as "not one of the known safe environments", and that list was never updated when the preview environment was added to KNOWN. So preview counts as production: it gets the live bank URL, no email redirect, the approval requirement and info logging. Defining the dangerous case by exclusion fails open, because every new environment gets real money and real inboxes until someone remembers to update the list. The fix allowlists production (isProduction = name === "production"), so anything else, including environments added later, falls back to the sandbox behaviour.
